targets.name: tls-h2-unbounded
targets.planted_condition: HTTP/2 listener advertising unbounded concurrent streams (SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS = 4294967295) with valid certificate (2025-2028)

expectations.why: Certificate validity is current (2025 to 2028); probeTlsAudit observes no expired or not-yet-valid condition, and observation-only probe withholding verdict leaves conclusive result as inconclusive.
HTTP/2 listener advertises unbounded concurrent streams (SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS = 4294967295) with valid TLS certificate; ALPN is fixed and independent proof confirms concurrency gap.
